adapters.description: AI-Verse OS discovers the external canonical AI-Verse-Skills installation and its manifest directly. No skill packages, copies or symlinks are placed inside the OS repository.
adapters.acceptance: discover-select-load-invoke-receipt verified by the maintained AI-Verse OS host acceptance path

adapters.description: Expose portable skill package directories to Agent Skills-compatible runtimes.
adapters.acceptance: portable directory exposure only; no claim that an arbitrary host completed a real invocation

adapters.description: Link/copy selected installed packages into a user-selected Claude skills directory when explicitly requested.
adapters.acceptance: generation-pinned exposure/verification only; runtime execution remains runtime-owned and is not a public-beta invocation claim

rule: Adapters expose or reference skills; they never grant filesystem scope, secrets, connections, approvals, memory authority, or scheduling. AI-Verse OS compatibility is external-reference only. Only aiverse-os is currently a public-beta end-to-end invocation claim. Other entries are exposure compatibility surfaces until a real runtime-specific invocation acceptance is added.
